mappings.name: resource-consistency
mappings.limitation: Shared-rule diagnostics require exact check/target attribution. Capture supplemental owning-rule diagnostics before suppression separately; do not add them to configured raw counts.

mappings.name: put-resource-marker
mappings.limitation: Marker metadata is distinct from canonical resource registration. Resource-shaped prioritization is not proof of a service defect.

comparison.audience: ARM production plus explicitly evaluated immutable ARM staging Spectral supplement
comparison.generalManyToMany: not executed; separate supported explicit mappings with no cross-product attribution or group-level equivalence inference
comparison.suppressionAccounting: Count captured responsible-rule diagnostics as covered checks even when authored suppressions prevent configured warnings; retain both quantities.

activation.assessment: Worker explicitly enables each mapping's selected rules; do not present marker findings as shared-profile default warnings.

expensiveGate.question: Measure the stable final marker implementation and actual HTTP response consistency repair on all unchanged frozen projects; establish exact gains, regressions, exceptions and unresolved authoring dependencies.
expensiveGate.estimatedNativeMinutes: 90-180 total for two supported mappings, plus artifact/control/evidence work
expensiveGate.budget: One final candidate checkpoint, with two complete explicit mapping runs. Planning allowance 240 minutes for native execution; no user-imposed ceiling. Preserve incomplete receipts and diagnose failures rather than truncating projects or refreshing Swagger.
expensiveGate.reusableEvidence: Pinned production/staging Swagger observations and source bindings. Old TypeSpec warnings do not validate changed source or compiler closure.
expensiveGate.validatorExecution: not-run; reuse immutable production and staging observations
expensiveGate.specFollowups: Separate source checkout and wire/client compatibility gates. Never modify frozen authored inputs or credit follow-up edits as unchanged-corpus coverage.

resources.exclusiveWriter: coordinator; same writable specs runtime reused serially

runtime.nonApplicableControls: Six controls require the absent resource-group-path-parameter migration; disclose rather than add an unrelated rule.
runtime.sourceValidation: 923 tests across 88 ARM/ruleset files, 23-package closure build plus final explicit-void ARM rebuild, compiled documentation violation/compliance examples, type-aware lint, root lint/format/spelling/changeset/diff checks passed. Global build/tests/docs were skipped in pre-PR helper in favor of recorded affected-closure checks.

conflicts: Resolve at end as requested. Any comparison-affecting resolution invalidates affected final coverage and requires fresh validation.
